candidate.user_submission: The child is 18 months old and has fever. The fever has lasted for 2 days. The measured temperature is 38.0°C. There is an identified bacterial cause of the fever. The area has high malaria risk. Malaria test is available and the test result is negative. The child does not have cough or difficult breathing. The child does not have diarrhoea. The child does not have any ear problem. The child is not convulsing now and has not had convulsions. The child is not lethargic or unconscious. The child is able to drink or breastfeed. The child does not vomit everything. There is no generalized rash. The child did not have measles within the last 3 months and is not having cough with measles. There is no obvious cause of fever found. The child does not have red eyes or runny nose. There is no stiff neck.
